newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron's Malaysian unit gets listing.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron's Malaysian unit gets listing.

text.p: Electronics group Goldtron Ltd said on Wednesday its Malaysian unit, Measurex Corp Bhd, has received approval for a listing on the second board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.

Goldtron currently owns about 80 percent of both Measurex Engineering Pte Ltd and Measurex Engineering (M) Sdn Bhd, both subsidiaries of Measurex Corp after a corporate restructuring to be undertaken in connection with the listing.
The Measurex group of companies makes hard disk drive components, primarily actuator arms.
Goldtron said a listing would enable the company to raise funds for its capital expenditure requirements.
